levels.name: No standards target
levels.description: Scenario Auditor cannot resolve a scenario or readable source tree for standards scanning.
exit_criteria: The target scenario resolves to readable files

levels.name: Standards scan available
levels.description: The standards provider can start, complete, and summarize a scan for the target scenario.
exit_criteria: A standards scan completes with structured violation data

levels.name: Scenario structure compliant
levels.description: Required scenario layout, service metadata, lifecycle health, and port conventions are present enough for ecosystem tools.
exit_criteria: No structure or configuration standards violations block lifecycle and discovery

levels.name: Service reliability standards compliant
levels.description: API, CLI, database, logging, and process-management standards are met well enough for repeated local operation.
exit_criteria: No service reliability standards violations block development operations

levels.name: Agent and testing standards compliant
levels.description: Agent-facing routing, test database, and automation standards are healthy enough for delegated improvement workflows.
exit_criteria: No agent or testing standards violations block Test Genie and playbook workflows

levels.name: Fleet-ready standards posture
levels.description: The scenario has no standards violations that block fleet validation, recurring standards scans, or automated remediation campaigns.
entry_criteria: Agent and testing standards are compliant
exit_criteria: No Scenario Auditor standards findings block fleet validation
